title: Patching a production database with no downtime
problem: AWS set a deadline for a mandatory operating-system patch on a customer's RDS database, and the production service had to stay up.
approach: I scheduled the patch ahead of the deadline and relied on Multi-AZ failover so production kept serving. I also flagged that the staging database was not Multi-AZ and would need a scheduled outage.
result: Effectively zero production downtime, with the patch applied before AWS's deadline.
lesson: Check which environments share the safety net before promising no downtime.
